    Pillai University, situated in New Panvel, Navi Mumbai, is widely recognized as one of the best universities in Mumbai for its multidisciplinary programs and industry-driven education. Approved by UGC, Pillai University offers undergraduate and postgraduate programs in Engineering, Business Administration, Architecture, Design, Sports Management and Computer Applications. With a 50+ year legacy under Mahatma Education Society, 95% placement rate, and 10 crore+ in research grants, Pillai University stands as a top choice for students across Maharashtra and India.

    Top Programs at Pillai University, Navi Mumbai

    Explore B.Tech, MBA, BBA, B.Arch, BCA, BDes, Sports Management, M.Tech and PhD programs with with industry-relevant specializations tailored for today's competitive world.

    Admissions Open – Apply to the Best University Near Mumbai

    Pillai University accepts admissions through PULSE (Pillai University Level Scholastic Exam) with scholarships up to 100%. No separate CET required. Apply now for UG and PG programs.
